title: Matching Markets: Equilibrium Computation, Indivisible Goods, and Positional Externalities
abstract: arXiv:2109.14850v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Matching markets provide a mathematical framework for allocating scarce resources among strategic agents with heterogeneous preferences. While matching without money relies on ordinal stability and Pareto efficiency, Fisher and Arrow--Debreu markets mediate allocation through budgets and market-clearing prices. In this paper, we study the convex-analytic foundations, computational complexity, and external-utility extensions of Fisher matching markets. First, we formulate fractional resource allocation and linear Fisher markets via Fenchel conjugate duality and the Karush--Kuhn--Tucker (KKT) conditions of the Eisenberg--Gale convex program, showing how budget-weighted Nash social welfare characterizes competitive equilibria across linear and homothetic utility families. Second, we review topological existence via Sperner's lemma alongside polynomial-time combinatorial algorithms for divisible markets, including the Devanur--Papa

translated_title: 匹配市场：均衡计算、不可分割物品与位置外部性
translated_abstract: 匹配市场为在具有异质偏好的策略性主体之间分配稀缺资源提供了一个数学框架。无货币的匹配依赖于序数稳定性和帕累托效率，而Fisher市场和Arrow–Debreu市场则通过预算和市场出清价格来调节分配。本文研究Fisher匹配市场的凸分析基础、计算复杂度以及外部效用扩展。首先，我们通过Fenchel共轭对偶和Eisenberg–Gale凸规划的Karush–Kuhn–Tucker (KKT)条件来表述分数资源分配与线性Fisher市场，展示了预算加权的纳什社会福利如何刻画线性和位似效用族下的竞争均衡。其次，我们回顾了基于Sperner引理的拓扑存在性证明，以及可分市场的多项式时间组合算法，包括Devanur–Papa（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文研究了Fisher匹配市场的凸分析基础与均衡计算，证明预算加权纳什社会福利可刻画线性和位似效用族下的竞争均衡，并系统回顾了可分物品与不可分割物品（含位置外部性）市场的存在性证明与多项式时间算法。
en_tdlr: This paper studies the convex-analytic foundations and equilibrium computation of Fisher matching markets, showing that budget-weighted Nash social welfare characterizes competitive equilibria for linear and homothetic utilities, and surveys existence proofs and polynomial-time algorithms for divisible and indivisible goods with positional externalities.
